Name: Earlier Blue Grass - Access a Meadowlands Farm Feature Easier
Author: ItsBenter
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LQeyWhM.png[/img]
This mod adds three methods to obtain Blue Grass earlier in non-Meadowlands Farm. Each can be enabled or disabled. By default, the config file is set to disable all three. You should choose what you'd like to have in your game.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Configuration Menu[/url]﻿ is strongly recommended to edit the config in-game instead of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Configure_mods]editing manually[/url], but it's your choice.

[b]1. Traveling Cart[/b]
You can set the minimum year, the chance Blue Grass Starter appearing in stock, and the price.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6RLMLIs.png[/img]

[b]2. Stardew Valley Fair[/b]
You can set the minimum year and the Star Tokens price.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QC7V7Fr.png[/img]

[b]3. Gift from Marnie[/b]
You can set the minimum year, farming level requirement, Marnie's heart requirement, and amount of Blue Grass Starter given.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3isC8jK.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CqcVhaz.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Fair and Traveling Cart might not work if other mod patch the whole shop.
[*]Technically should work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HNm7QJU.png[/img]
1. Can I use this mod in an ongoing save?
Yes, you can. The mod effect will take place immediately after added and configured.

2. Can I use this mod in multiplayer?
Yes, you can. Ideally with the mod installed and with same configuration on all players.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WtvzZ9s.png[/img]
